Players Committee card image of [[Black Sun Blaster]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Use 1 Force to deploy on your alien warrior (free if your Black Sun agent leader on table). May target a character or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. If destiny +1 > defense value, target hit and you may activate 1 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/1fa635b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Black%20Sun%20Blaster.gif Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Dark/Large/Black Sun Blaster.gif] as of commit 1fa635b “virtual set 13 cards” (9 November 2020).
